thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PDINC-45678 — high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-usw2 (5xx rate 6.2% over 5m). Auto-page to #incidents.

pagerduty: Triggered by policy 'gateway-5xx-spike'. Escalation: primary oncall. Incident link: https://pd.internal/incidents/PDINC-45678

sanjay: acked. I'm the lead. quick check: is this across all regions or just usw2?

anya: seeing the same spike in telemetry for usw2 only, latency normal-ish, errors are mostly 502/504.

oncall-sre: I'm on the bridge. getting cluster metrics...

jordan: tagging in from infra. can you paste the failed request log snippets?

mai: `grep "502" /var/log/gateway/proxy.log | tail -n 50` shows backlog errors and a bunch of `upstream connection reset by peer`. Could be backend kv cache evictions or a noisy pod.

sanjay: running quick health commands:```
kubectl -n inference-gateway get pods -o wide | egrep "gateway|proxy"
# current: 6/8 gateway-proxy- pods Ready=85%
kubectl -n inference-gateway top pods | sort -rk2 | head
```

anya: I see two gateway pods with >90% CPU and high socket errors. Also KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% around spike start.

jordan: scaling gateway pool by +3 to absorb burst. `k scale deployment gateway-proxy --replicas=11 -n inference-gateway`

incident-bot: Action executed: scaled deployment gateway-proxy to 11 replicas.

mai: rolling restart of the two high-sock-error pods suggested. command: ``kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-proxy -n inference-gateway --field-selector metadata.name=gateway-proxy-7`` — but let's avoid full rollout until we confirm.

sanjay: can we route traffic away from the noisy node group? Which AZs are these pods on?

jordan: noisy pods are on us-west2-b. I'll cordon nodes hosting them and drain gracefully: `kubectl drain node-uw2b-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

oncall-sre: draining node now. moving ~2200 connections off.

status-bot: Notifying: status.redwood.ai - incident PDINC-45678 - "Increased 5xx rate in US-WEST2". Customer impact: partial, degraded responses for subset of requests.

anya: customer impact estimate: ~2% of total requests failing, skewed to long-sequence requests (seq_len>1024). Two customers (acct: acme, acct: beta-ml) reported elevated errors via support.

sanjay: mitigation plan: 1) scale gateway (done), 2) drain noisy nodes (in progress), 3) enable fallback routing to canary-model-compact for long-seq requests for 15m, 4) investigate KV cache misses and backend timeouts. If error rate drops below 1% in 15m we'll keep monitoring.

jordan: enabled fallback routing rule: `redwoodctl routes apply --name fallback-longseq --match "seq_len>1024" --target canary-model-compact --ttl 900`

incident-bot: Route change applied: fallback-longseq -> canary-model-compact (TTL 900s).

mai: after scale + drain + route fallback, 5xx rate down to 1.4% over 5m. continuing to watch.

anya: logs from backend show `redis: out of memory` spikes around time of incident, KV eviction rate jumped. Might be caching layer.

jordan: opening a ticket to infra: INFRA-789 for redis cluster in usw2. pinging infra oncall.

sanjay: good. if redis is the root cause we may need to increase memory or add replicas. For now fallback routing reduces surface.

oncall-sre: handoff: I need to step out in 30m. Jordan will take over ops lead after that.

jordan: taking over after 30m. I'll monitor for the next 60m then coordinate post-incident.

mai: quick check to verify client-side retries: looked at gateway headers — backend responded with 502 before retrying. We'll add a short retry-backoff for long-sequence calls as a safety net (5s window).

sanjay: agreed. small retry policy change applied to canary route only.

status-bot: Status update posted to dashboard: "Mitigation in progress. Error rate reduced from 6.2% -> 1.4%. Partial customer impact. Next update in 20m."

pagerduty: PDINC-45678 - acknowledged by sanjay. Escalation paused.

anya: note for postmortem: correlate sequence length distribution, kv cache evictions, and redis memory pressure. Add eval suite to catch long-seq patterns causing cache thrash.

sanjay: agreed. if by 30m we stay <1% we close pager. otherwise escalate to SRE oncall manager.

oncall-sre: leaving handoff to jordan. thanks all. :thumbsup:

jordan: will keep thread updated. next update ~ +20m.

status-bot: Final note (20m check): 5xx rate now 0.9% over 5m, customer reports from acme/beta-ml have subsided. Monitoring continues.

sanjay: closing incident in PD in 25m if stable. Postmortem owners: anya (cause), jordan (infra fix), mai (runtime changes).

incident-bot: PDINC-45678 set to 'monitoring'. Auto-close criteria: 30m stable <1% 5xx.

jordan: adding runbook link and next steps: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inference-high-5xx — please add logs and commands used.

mai: dropping the key commands I ran into the runbook excerpt:```
# quick checks
kubectl -n inference-gateway get pods -o wide
kubectl logs -n inference-gateway gateway-proxy-7 -c proxy --since=15m | egrep "error|502|504" | head -n 120
redis-cli -h redis-usw2-1 INFO memory | egrep "used_memory_human|maxmemory"
```

sanjay: thanks. will follow up with postmortem once infra ticket INFRA-789 has remediation plan. closing updates in thread when PD closed. :white_check_mark:

status-bot: Update posted: incident still in monitoring, next summary at +60m.
